name: Homeless men
source: Residents of vinyl greenhouses along the river near the sharehouse the pair moved in. Reiko was asked by a former colleague from her announcer days to cover the story about some of them making a fortune through day trading. She accepted, but this became her entry point into a swamp of depravity.
